real_data: Frozen submitted CelebA binary roots: 128 identities, 512 probes, 512 bits
retrieval: Union of all exact block buckets; deduplicate locators; stable gallery-row tie breaking
certification: If all gallery rows are retrieved, the search is exhaustive already. Otherwise, with no queried overflow, a nonretrieved record differs in every block, so distance >= number_of_blocks. Accept an index winner only if its distance is strictly smaller; otherwise full-scan fallback. Also fall back on any queried bucket overflow when the candidate set is incomplete.
evidence_boundary: Python/SHAKE reference execution only. CPU timings are not MPC timings, do not measure communication, and do not establish access-pattern privacy. Synthetic scaling is computational evidence only, never biometric utility.
float_comparison: Requires original per-image floating embeddings or re-extraction; impossible to reconstruct from sign bits.
